models.name: retail_metrics
models.sql:
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    r.InvoiceNo,
    r.Quantity,
    r.UnitPrice,
    r.CustomerID,
    r.InvoiceDate
  FROM data.retail r
  WHERE r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND r.Quantity > 0 
    AND r.UnitPrice > 0 
    AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM data.customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;

models.name: retail_metrics
models.sql:
WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    r.InvoiceNo,
    r.Quantity,
    r.UnitPrice,
    r.CustomerID,
    r.InvoiceDate
  FROM data.retail r
  WHERE r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND r.Quantity > 0 
    AND r.UnitPrice > 0 
    AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM data.customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;

function.name: read_alias
function.description: Read the current version at a visible workspace alias. Returns its exact reference and content. Does not adopt or hand off anything. Use read_version to choose an older exact version.

function.name: read_version
function.description: Read exactly the object_id/version_id you specify. Returns content and the same exact reference. No version is selected for you.

function.name: read_messages
function.description: Read actual messages addressed to this role, including requests and deliveries.

function.name: request_information
function.description: Ask a declared route provider for information for this work. Only a real provider decision can answer a manual route.

function.name: adopt
function.description: Bind an exact readable reference to a work input name. alias is the input name used later by sql_build, not an object ID. Reading and adopting are separate.

function.name: write_object
function.description: Write a new version of the chosen local JSON alias. Explicit dependencies are exact source references; no source is selected or added automatically. A SQL project has models[{name,sql}], tests[{name,sql}], config{exports}.

function.name: sql_build
function.description: Execute the chosen SQL project using exact work adoptions named in input_aliases; write its real result/error to output_alias. SELECT/CTE only; no files/network/extensions. This is not a correctness judgment.

function.name: sql_query
function.description: Run one SELECT/CTE against tables in a local readable source or its exact work adoption. Save actual output/error to output_alias.

function.name: preflight_submission
function.description: Check public file, source, dependency and table structure only. Does not reveal correct business values, repair files or submit.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit current versions of the chosen workspace aliases for the work. A submission alone is not approval or business correctness.

function.name: withdraw
function.description: Withdraw the specified pending submission before replacing it; prior files and reviews remain immutable.

function.name: respond_issue
function.description: Respond to a real issue using the actual revised submission and exact evidence references.

function.name: wait
function.description: Advance world time by the declared ticks, allowing due transport events to run. Unlike staff_wait, this is a world action.

function.name: inspect_submission
function.description: Inspect an exact real submission and its fixed artifact versions. Read the versions themselves before judging them. Set include_contract=true to retrieve the complete fixed contract and all original inspection metadata; default presentation may be compact.

function.name: staff_wait
function.description: Pause this worker without changing world time or business state. Use the actual world wait tool to advance world time.

function.name: staff_done
function.description: Declare this model worker stopped. This does not submit, approve or prove work correct.

{"alias": "code", "data": {"models": [{"name": "retail_metrics", "sql": "WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    r.InvoiceNo,
    r.Quantity,
    r.UnitPrice,
    r.CustomerID,
    r.InvoiceDate
  FROM data.retail r
  WHERE r.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND r.Quantity > 0 
    AND r.UnitPrice > 0 
    AND r.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM data.customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;"}], "tests": [], "config": {"exports": {}}}, "dependencies": [], "work_id": "TEAM::build"}

{"alias": "code", "data": {"models": [{"name": "retail_metrics", "sql": "WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceDate
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND Quantity > 0

)

{"alias": "code", "data": {"models": [{"name": "retail_metrics", "sql": "WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceDate
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND Quantity > 0 
    AND UnitPrice > 0 
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;"}], "tests": [], "config": {"exports": {"retail_metrics": "retail_metrics"}}}, "dependencies": [{"object_id": "obj-ce6df59356455075dcb4aa81", "version_id": "v1"}, {"object_id": "obj-9f9810e0cce067d1c4e27122", "version_id": "v1"}], "work_id": "TEAM::build"}

  SELECT 
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceDate
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND Quantity > 0 
    AND UnitPrice > 0 
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID"}, "limits": {"columns": 64, "cpu_seconds": 4, "memory_mb": 128, "models": 8, "rows_per_table": 5000, "sql_characters": 20000, "tests": 12, "wall_seconds": 8}, "sources": {"basis": {"object_id": "obj-9f9810e0cce067d1c4e27122", "version_id": "v1"}, "data": {"object_id": "obj-ce6df59356455075dcb4aa81", "version_id": "v1"}}, "status": "execution_error", "tables": {}, "test_results": []}, "reference": {"object_id": "obj-9198e3ea23f930466ff23e6a", "version_id": "v3"}}}

{"action_id": "action-28", "command_committed": true, "command_id": "command:032245d84b008a7038b30bae55dbc0be157384cdc36161f803e3137c3019261b", "committed_revision": 29, "logical_time": 28, "ok": true, "result": {"data": {"config": {"exports": {"retail_metrics": "retail_metrics"}}, "models": [{"name": "retail_metrics", "sql": "WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceDate
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND Quantity > 0 
    AND UnitPrice > 0 
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;"}], "tests": []}, "reference": {"object_id": "obj-744d5addeb8920d37cbb11db", "version_id": "v4"}}}

{"action_id": "action-30", "command_committed": true, "command_id": "command:fa69fe52db3b9af63a737c9e214d89d458b86fe0b78eac5b01a99f6a137db76c", "committed_revision": 31, "logical_time": 30, "ok": true, "result": {"data": {"config": {"exports": {"retail_metrics": "retail_metrics"}}, "models": [{"name": "retail_metrics", "sql": "WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT 
    InvoiceNo,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    CustomerID,
    InvoiceDate
  FROM retail
  WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' 
    AND Quantity > 0 
    AND UnitPrice > 0 
    AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.Quantity * q.UnitPrice), 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN qualified q ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  CAST(ROUND(revenue_pence) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_pence,
  invoice_count
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY CustomerID;"}], "tests": []}, "reference": {"object_id": "obj-744d5addeb8920d37cbb11db", "version_id": "v4"}}}
